snippet.title: Deathmatch - Team Fortress 2 Classic: Community Edition | Gamemode Gameplay
snippet.description:
Name: Team Fortress 2 Classic: Community Edition
Version: Fix Pack 5.0.0
Download: https://hdmineface.github.io/download.html
Mod Discord Server: https://discord.gg/7JStYpQbwM
Wiki Article: https://wiki.tf2sourcemods.info/Team_Fortress_2_Classic:_Community_Edition

Team Fortress 2 Classic: Community Edition, also referred to as TF2C:CE or Pre-Split, is a spin-off mod of Team Fortress 2 Classic's final build, 2.0.0 SVN Final DM Commit, which contained the final version of their Deathmatch mode before it was cut and turned into its own sourcemod called Team Deathmatch Classic developed by Compucolor Pictures. TF2C:CE aims to keep the removed Deathmatch mode alive by picking up development right where it left off. They plan to do this by finishing the Deathmatch mode while also maintaining existing features.
